item.title: Week 11: Steelers at Eagles
item.description: Sun 11/22 · 4:25 PM ET | Line: PIT -4.5 · O/U 38.5 | Model PHI 37% vs. market 36% | Pittsburgh has to keep leaning on the run, where its designed carries rank first in EPA, while the Eagles must avoid getting stuffed on early downs all season. Jaylen Warren gains +2.1 rushing yards over expected per carry, and he runs at a Philadelphia run defense ranked 16th. Our model and the market agree within a point on Pittsburgh, with the rushing matchup adding 6.2 points toward the Steelers.
